note: This slice adds a single guarded connection.close() on the DatabaseError except-path of the nightly retention purge helpers (tasks.py) and the monthly tune tasks (tasks_tuning.py), plus the two convention-named test modules that let the diff-scoped mutation gate discover them. The changed lines run only when a maintenance query has already failed; they are pure I/O (close a pooled PostgreSQL connection) and are not on any CPU compute hot-path. There are zero legacy compute-Python lines here warranting a native (C++/Go/Rust) rewrite: a native rewrite of an error-path connection.close() gives no measurable gain and would only add a cross-language boundary. python_lines_remaining=0 means 'compute-Python lines warranting native rewrite', which is correct for this error-path correctness fix.

baseline.workload: raise DatabaseError inside the maintenance task, take the except branch, close the pooled connection, then write ErrorLog on a fresh connection
